description: Painting of a red and black stagecoach pulled by two bay horses on a muddy road at dusk. A guard in a red coat and tricorn hat blows a long brass post horn from the rear, and a driver in a dark coat and hat holds the reins on the box. A trunk is strapped on the roof and lanterns are lit on the coach. The sky is stormy and dark with an orange sunset glow, and a crest is on the door. Oil-painting style, no visible text, no visible frame.
